# Albert

> Albert is a comprehensive edtech platform providing free test prep resources, practice materials, and learning management solutions for AP, SAT, ACT, and other standardized exams.

Albert offers both free blog resources and integrated LMS solutions for students and teachers preparing for major standardized tests. The platform serves educators and learners through multiple channels including study guides, practice tools, and institutional integrations.

## Key Topics

- AP Exams
- SAT/ACT
- Test Prep
- Study Resources
- Score Calculators
- Standardized Testing
- EdTech
- LMS Integrations
- Canvas
- Google Classroom
- Free Tools
- Exam Guides
- Regents
- PSAT

## Test Prep & Study Resources

- [Albert Blog & Resources](https://www.albert.io/blog): Blog with free test prep resources for AP, SAT, ACT exams and student study guides

## Learning Management & Integrations

- [LMS Integrations](https://www.albert.io/solutions/integrations): Albert LMS integrations with Canvas, Schoology, Google Classroom, D2L BrightSpace

## Help & Support

- [Albert Help Center](https://help.albert.io): Albert Help Center with FAQs and documentation for teachers, students, and admins

## Optional

- [Careers at Learn By Doing, Inc.](https://careers.albert.io): Careers page for Learn By Doing, Inc. showcasing jobs, culture, and benefits
